title: Patient portal
description: One place for appointments, results over time, symptom notes and direct messages to the care team.

title: Standards-based records
description: Record exchange built on HL7 and FHIR R4, so charts stay consistent across the systems a health network already runs.

title: Assisted documentation
description: Draft visit notes generated during a consultation, always reviewed and signed off by the clinician before they enter the record.
